facts.fact: Veronica 在自家公寓厨房擦干 Nick 手洗的最后一批银器，并再次数落他太天真。
facts.anchor: drying the last of the silverware Nick had hand-washed in the kitchen sink in her apartment

facts.fact: Veronica 说 Nick 想做的是追猎不愿被找到的恶物，那是反间谍的活。
facts.anchor: What you’re talking about is playing Ahab, hunting something evil that doesn’t want to be found

facts.fact: Nick 说自己一生只效力过两个优秀组织：一家评论刊物和一家顶级咨询公司。
facts.anchor: I’ve worked for two excellent organizations in my life

facts.fact: Nick 引用 BUTTONFLY 的话，主张给中情局精简瘦身、卸掉铅块，让它重新去干活。
facts.anchor: we just need to pare way down, take off the lead weights, and set the Agency free to go and do her job once more

facts.fact: 简报人在会上宣布把新通信系统推广到整个中国线人网。
facts.anchor: We’re going to roll it out across the entire Chinese agent base — all of them

facts.fact: Veronica 在会上质疑：同一国家的多个线人是否该共用同一套系统。
facts.anchor: Are we sure we should provide the same system to multiple agents in the same country?

facts.fact: 会上没有其他提问，只有甜腻的下午、甜甜圈和空话。
facts.anchor: There were no other questions, just a cloying afternoon of donuts and flim-flam

facts.fact: 尼克问“你喜欢几分熟的性”，维罗妮卡高喊“全熟，间谍操蛋鬼”。
